column2: Run this only against systems you own or have written authorisation to assess. It sends TCP connects, UDP datagrams and (with -Icmp) ICMP echoes to the hosts and ports the profile and -Set declare, plus DNS lookups for host names. It does not exploit or log in to anything and reads only what classifies each port. You are responsible for handling that output and for having permission to run it.
All probes were sent from redacted; Source values are labels from the profile.
